docs.title: ITS Ontology for Transport Network
docs.text:
Ontology that imports the transport-network pattern modules for transport-network, road, rail, pedestrian, micromobility, public transport, travel corridor, and alerts. All transport network elements are derived from geo:Feature via imports of the ITS Location ontology.

License: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The ITS Ontology for Transport Network consists of the following patterns:

  • Micromobility Network
  • Pedestrian Network
  • Public Transport System
  • Rail Network
  • Road Network
  • Transport Alert
  • Transport Network
  • Travel Corridor

The formal definition of this ontology is available in TURTLE Syntax.

docs.title: Specializations of NetworkElement
docs.text: Class Description Footpath A travelled way intended primarily for pedestrians. Footpath Lane A lane or channel along a footpath. Footpath Link A directed footpath link between nodes. Footpath Section A contiguous section of a footpath. Footpath Segment A homogeneous segment of a footpath. Junction A transport node where two or more travelled ways or links connect. Micromobility Lane A lane along a micromobility path. Micromobility Link A directed micromobility link between nodes. Micromobility Path A travelled way intended for micromobility modes. Micromobility Path Section A contiguous section of a micromobility path. Micromobility Path Segment A homogeneous segment of a micromobility path. Point On Route A point feature locating a stop, timing point, or other position on a route. Public Transport Element Abstract element of a public transport system (line, route, stop, etc.). Public Transport Line The linear geometry or reference for a public transport line (service corridor). Public Transport Route The linear geometry or reference for a specific public transport route variant. Rail Corridor A two-dimensional rail corridor footprint or influence area. Rail Section A contiguous section of a rail alignment. Road A travelled way intended for motor vehicle or mixed road traffic. Road Lane A lane along a road. Road Link A directed road network link between nodes. Road Section A contiguous section of a road in a road referencing scheme. Road Segment A homogeneous segment of a road. Route Point A point feature along a route alignment (e.g., shape point or service point). Track Link A directed rail track link between nodes. Track Segment A homogeneous segment of track. Transport Node A point feature at which network links may meet or which anchors linear topology. Travel Corridor A linear reference for a travel corridor axis (multimodal or policy corridor). Travel Corridor Link A directed link that is part of a travel corridor network. Travel Corridor Segment A segment that is part of a travel corridor. Travelled Way A linear feature representing a generic travelled way (centreline or reference line). Travelled Way Lane A linear feature for a single lane along a travelled way. Travelled Way Link A linear feature representing a directed edge between two transport nodes in a network graph. Travelled Way Section A linear feature that aggregates or references a contiguous portion of a travelled way. Travelled Way Segment A linear feature for the smallest homogeneous piece of a travelled way in a given segmentation scheme.

docs.title: ITS Ontology - Transport Network - Core Pattern
docs.text:
Core abstractions shared across transport network pattern modules (road, rail, pedestrian, micromobility, public transport, travel corridor, alerts), grounded on the ITS Location ontology features and geometries.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/location/v1/AreaPattern
  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/location/v1/LinearPattern
  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/location/v1/LocationCorePattern
  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/location/v1/PointPattern

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Junction
  • Network Element
  • Scheduled Code
  • Transport Network
  • Transport Network Thing
  • Transport Node
  • Travelled Way
  • Travelled Way Lane
  • Travelled Way Link
  • Travelled Way Section

  • Travelled Way Segment This module defines the following properties:

  • hasEndNode

  • hasStartNode
  • partOfTravelCorridor
  • partOfTravelledWay
  • TransportNetworkObjectProperty

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax in two files, the core semantics and the SHACL restrictions.

docs.title: ITS Ontology - Transport Network - Travel Corridor Pattern
docs.text:
Travel corridor concepts that are derived from ITS Location features and can be presented with multiple geometries.

This pattern imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/itsdata/transport-network/v1/TransportNetworkPattern

This pattern consists of the following classes:

  • Travel Corridor
  • Travel Corridor Link
  • Travel Corridor Segment

The formal definition of this pattern is available in TURTLE Syntax in two files, the core semantics and the SHACL restrictions.

docs.title: Specializations of TravelledWay
docs.text: Class Description Footpath A travelled way intended primarily for pedestrians. Micromobility Path A travelled way intended for micromobility modes. Road A travelled way intended for motor vehicle or mixed road traffic.

docs.title: TravelledWayLink
docs.text: A linear feature representing a directed edge between two transport nodes in a network graph.

docs.title: Specializations of TravelledWayLink
docs.text: Class Description Footpath Link A directed footpath link between nodes. Micromobility Link A directed micromobility link between nodes. Road Link A directed road network link between nodes. Track Link A directed rail track link between nodes. Travel Corridor Link A directed link that is part of a travel corridor network.

docs.title: partOfTravelCorridor
docs.text:

docs.title: partOfTravelledWay

IRI: https://w3id.org/itsdata/transport-network/v1/partOfTravelledWay
